description:
Returns cumulative degree-day indicators (heating/cooling/growing) for a location and period using ERA5 reanalysis data.
When to use: Estimate energy demand anomalies or agricultural stress in a recent or upcoming period.
Date format: YYYYMMDD for ymd_start and ymd_end. Maximum interval is 14 days per call.
Performance: Computed on demand using ERA5; moderate speed. Keep intervals to ≤14 days.
Prerequisites: Requires lat/lon directly — no locid needed.
Investigate: Use when the query involves power grid strain or energy demand. For forecast context, use future ymd dates.
Augment: Adds quantitative energy-demand context to heatwave or cold snap stories. Returns: meta, indicators.

base_temp_C.description: Base temperature in °C for all indicators (default: 18.3)

indicators.description: Comma separated list of indicator names. ['hdd'|'cdd'|'wbcdd'|'gdd] (default: hdd,cdd,wbcdd)

unit.description: Degree days as measured in F|C (default: C)

name: degreedays
title: Degree Days
